compliancePosture: Aggregate region-level statistics only; no individual sold prices; every figure n>=5. Cite figures verbatim.

angles.headline: 20% of active Whitby listings have cut their asking price

angles.headline: The typical active Richmond Hill listing has now sat 111 days
